subject: Request: Shortstop credits to keep eval live while Procurement validates PO
messages:
From: Arman Shah <arman@newleafhealth.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Eval window pause — procurement validation

Hi Connor,

Quick update from our side — procurement is still validating the PO and Finance put a hold on new vendor onboarding while they reconcile a quarterly invoice. The engineers have been running short smoke tests and the team found the model latency/throughput profiles helpful, but the eval timer is counting down.

Is there a way to keep the sandbox/live evaluation active for a short window while procurement finishes validation? We won't be able to finalize the PO until Friday at the earliest, and I don't want the team to lose the momentum. Even a small temporary credit allocation (72 hours) would let us finish the integration tests.

Happy to share the PO status and point you to our procurement contact if you need verification.

Thanks,
Arman Shah
Director of Platforms, NewLeaf Health
arman@newleafhealth.com
Procurement contact: procurement@newleafhealth.com

[Attachment: newleaf_po_pending.pdf (stub) ]

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: Arman Shah <arman@newleafhealth.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2026 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Eval window pause — procurement validation

Hi Arman — thanks for the heads up and for sharing the PO stub. Appreciate the transparency.

We can provision a shortstop credit allowance to keep your eval environment live while procurement closes out. Typically we do this as a conditional 72-hour token allotment tied to an incoming PO or signed SOW; since you indicated Friday ETA, that should cover the gap.

Can you confirm:
- PO number (if available) or the name of the approver in procurement
- Expected date/time the finance hold will clear

I'll loop in Grace from Sales Ops to approve the one-time credit, and copy Finance (David) for the tracking. If you can forward procurement's confirmation email, that accelerates the internal approval.

Connor O'Brien
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com
Phone: +1 415-555-0123

Subject: Requesting conditional 72-hour credit for NewLeaf Health (deal NLH-2026-045) — PO pending

Team — forwarding Arman's note (attached PO stub). NewLeaf's procurement hold is blocking onboarding; engineering needs a short window to finish integration tests.

Proposal: Approve a conditional 72-hour eval credit (estimated ~35K tokens / low-utilization) to preserve momentum. Conditions:
- Credit auto-expire after 72 hours;
- Credit released only if we receive PO confirmation within 120 hours;
- Finance will invoice/offset against PO once cleared.

Attachments: newleaf_po_pending.pdf (from Arman), connor_credit_request_note.txt (internal estimate)

Reasoning: customer is a strategic healthcare prospect (NewLeaf) with clear timeline and committed technical resources; losing the eval now risks derailing the pilot.

Please approve or suggest edits; if approved I will reply to Arman and provision the credit.

Thanks,
Connor
